PYTHONPATH=. python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, sys
# inline family field presence checks (same as remint harness)
from calm.hrm_text_158.bit_linear import BitLinear
import torch
from calm.hrm_text_158.native_full_stack.trainer_sub2_authority import (
  build_trainer_sub2_authority_local_update_receipt,
  SPARSE_VOTE_AUTHORITY_MODE_FUSED_ONLY,
)
class T(torch.nn.Module):
  def __init__(self):
    super().__init__(); self.lin=BitLinear(4,4,bias=False)
  def forward(self,x): return self.lin(x)
m=T(); m.lin.weight.data.zero_(); m.lin.weight.data.add_(0.1)
b={'x':torch.randn(2,4),'target':torch.randn(2,4)}
r=build_trainer_sub2_authority_local_update_receipt(model=m,batch=b,forward_loss_fn=lambda m,b: torch.nn.functional.mse_loss(m(b['x']),b['target']),use_ternary_bulk=True,device=torch.device('cpu'),sparse_vote_authority_mode=SPARSE_VOTE_AUTHORITY_MODE_FUSED_ONLY)
vp=r.vote_projection_proof; assert 'sparse_event_map_binding_sha256_by_key' in vp
pk=next(iter(r.candidate_step_summary['candidate_local_update_proof_by_key'].values()))
assert isinstance(pk.get('candidate_bounded_decode_sha256_after'), str) and len(pk['candidate_bounded_decode_sha256_after'])==64
print('CHAR_OK')
PY
